entries.title: Point at turns off once it picks a part of a card
entries.body: After Point at picks a part or words on a card, it turns itself off while your note opens, so a later click on the card is an ordinary click again. To point at another part, turn Point at on again. Your iPhone and iPad do the same.

picture.alt: A card with one note on its second paragraph waiting in its thread, and the Point at button beside the reply field no longer lit
